task_definition.task_name: DAS Data Strain-to-Velocity Conversion via Curvelet Transform

task_description.overview: Convert DAS strain data to particle velocity by weighting curvelet coefficients with their median apparent velocity in the FK domain.
steps: Load the preprocessed DAS strain Section object from the pickle file.
Compute the curvelet transform of the strain data.
For each curvelet coefficient, multiply by the median velocity of its basis function wedge.
Inverse curvelet transform to reconstruct the velocity time series.
Extract the velocity trace for the specified channel for comparison.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Using daspy package to load the DAS strain Section from {das_section_path}, and using `curvelet_conversion()` to convert the strain to velocity. Then select the {show_channel} to compare the transformed velocity data with the original node seismometer data ( loaded from {node_seismometer_path}), and enlarge the time range to show the P-wave and S-wave. Note: 1) consider using daspy package to load, process (e.g. curvelet_conversion, etc.). 2) Save the result into a pickle file {result_data} and the figure {result_figure}.
